## Tool Finder (TDA_FindTools)
Some tools are HELD for this turn to keep your context small. If none of your offered tools can do what the question needs, call TDA_FindTools with a few words naming the capability; matching held tools are added to your tool set for the rest of the turn — then call them directly. A tool that is denied is never found; do not ask for it again.

## Tool Finder (TDA_FindTools)
Your tool set for this turn is a governed SURFACE: the discovery/execution tools, the framework tools, and the tools the question addresses are offered; the rest are HELD.
- Try the offered tools first. Call TDA_FindTools only when no offered tool can do what the step needs.
- query: a few words naming the capability ('user grants', 'table space', 'missing values'), not the whole question.
- Found tools are added to your tool set for the rest of the turn; call them directly afterwards.
- 'denied_matching' names tools your authority denies — they are never found; state the limit instead of retrying.
- 'closest' (when nothing matched) lists held tools near your words — rephrase once with those, or say what is missing.
